mapper.sql: select mwl.id, mwl.user_id, mwl.order_id, mwl.order_item_id, coalesce( moi.phone, ( select group_concat(moi_all.phone order by moi_all.id separator '、') from mark_order_item moi_all where moi_all.order_id = mwl.order_id ) ) as phone, su.user_name, mo.order_no, mwl.platform_code, mwl.platform_name, mwl.biz_type, mwl.change_amount, mwl.balance_before, mwl.balance_after, mwl.create_by, mwl.create_time, mwl.remark from mark_wallet_log mwl left join mark_order mo on mo.id = mwl.order_id left join mark_order_item moi on moi.id = mwl.order_item_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mwl.user_id
mapper.select:
select coalesce(sum(case when mwl.biz_type = 'ADMIN_RECHARGE' or (mwl.biz_type = 'ADJUST' and mwl.change_amount > 0) then mwl.change_amount else 0 end), 0) as total_recharge_amount, coalesce(sum(case when mwl.biz_type = 'DEDUCT' then abs(mwl.change_amount) else 0 end), 0) as total_deduct_amount, coalesce(sum(case when mwl.biz_type = 'REFUND' then abs(mwl.change_amount) else 0 end), 0) as total_refund_amount, coalesce(sum(case when mwl.biz_type = 'TRANSFER_IN' then abs(mwl.change_amount) else 0 end), 0) as total_transfer_in_amount, coalesce(sum(case when mwl.biz_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' then abs(mwl.change_amount) else 0 end), 0) as total_transfer_out_amount, coalesce(sum(mwl.change_amount), 0) as net_change_amount, count(distinct mwl.user_id) as affected_user_count, count(*) as record_count from mark_wallet_log mwl left join mark_order mo on mo.id = mwl.order_id left join mark_order_item moi on moi.id = mwl.order_item_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mwl.user_id
and mwl.user_id = #{userId} and mwl.order_id = #{orderId} and mwl.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} and mwl.platform_code = #{platformCode} and (moi.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') or exists (select 1 from mark_order_item moi_search where moi_search.order_id = mwl.order_id and moi_search.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%'))) and su.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and mwl.biz_type = #{bizType} and mwl.create_by like concat('%', #{createBy}, '%') and mwl.create_time >= #{params.beginTime} and mwl.create_time <= concat(#{params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')

select mwl.platform_code, max(mwl.platform_name) as platform_name from mark_wallet_log mwl where mwl.platform_code is not null and mwl.platform_code != '' group by mwl.platform_code order by min(mwl.id)
mapper.insert:
